sm_top.sm: Jordanian Air Force strikes suspected Islamic State positions in southern Syria following a church attack in Karak.
The Houthis claimed responsibility for attacks on East-West oil pumping stations in Saudi Arabia, though there was no immediate Saudi confirmation.
Riyadh airport partially reopened following previous attacks.
The Saudi-led coalition says it destroyed three drones over Riyadh and southern Saudi Arabia.
The Houthis claimed missile and drone strikes targeting Saudi Arabia's Ras Tanura oil refinery and defense facilities.
Romania blamed Russia after a drone strike sank a cargo ship in the Black Sea, killing a sailor and leaving three missing.
Jordanian security forces arrested three suspects following a deadly church shooting attack.
The Saudi-led coalition stated it destroyed Houthi missile facilities.
Ukrainian police released footage following ballistic missile strikes on Kyiv.
An oil tanker was disabled in the Strait of Hormuz amid escalating Gulf shipping risks.
A suspected Houthi missile landed near a military headquarters in Aden, causing explosions.

A drone attack causes power outages across large parts of Sudan's capital, Khartoum.
Iran claimed it shot down a U.S. LUCAS attack drone operating near the Strait of Hormuz.
Attacks killed at least 60 Orthodox Christians in Ethiopia.

Russian forces captured territory and launched attacks in the Zaporizhzhia region.
An Al-Shabaab ambush causes heavy losses, while Somalia claims 75 militants were killed.

Ukrainian air defenses intercepted missiles and drones in an overnight attack.
The Israeli military conducted a large-scale operation in the West Bank.
Gunmen attacked a community in Nigeria, leaving 62 people dead.
An investigation revealed that the RSF systematically targeted the healthcare system in El Fasher.
Major General Abdollahi claimed the Strait of Hormuz is completely closed under Iranian arrangements and threatened safety for violating ships.
Ansarallah launched missile and drone strikes hitting a camp in Shabwa, resulting in dozens of fatalities among security personnel.
The EU released €4.9 billion under the European Peace Facility to support Ukraine with military aid reimbursements and training.
Reports indicate that the Black Sea has surpassed the Strait of Hormuz as the world's deadliest route for merchant shipping.
The death toll from a Russian drone strike on a park in Kharkiv Oblast rose to six.
Russian forces attacked an energy facility in Khmelnytskyi Oblast, causing power cuts.
Yemeni Houthis claimed missile strikes targeting the Saudi Defence Ministry and the Ras Tanura oil refinery.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that Russia has fired over 100 ballistic missiles at Kyiv and the surrounding region over the past two weeks.
A UN commission reports that over 1,000 Palestinians have been killed in the West Bank since October 2023.
Yemen's Houthis claim an attack on a Saudi oil refinery as blasts shake Riyadh.
A drone attack on a passenger bus in Zaporizhzhia resulted in one death.
Russian air defense forces intercepted and destroyed 222 Ukrainian drones over multiple regions and the Black Sea overnight.
Russian air defense forces report destroying 290 Ukrainian drones overnight across multiple regions.
